summary:
MISSIONFORGE addresses the Space Mission Design Game challenge by turning mission planning into a hands-on, browser-based learning experience. The player begins with a Mars exploration scenario and selects an objective, spacecraft components, a launch-vehicle class and an orbit profile. Component choices affect modeled cost, mass, power demand, power generation, data generation, storage and downlink capacity. The dashboard recalculates these values immediately and flags constraints that need attention.

When the player runs the simulation, the application checks whether the design meets the simplified scenario requirements and returns a mission assessment with a score and explanatory feedback. Players can revise their design and run the assessment again. This demonstrates that a mission is a connected system: a science instrument may increase science capability while also increasing mass, power demand, data volume and cost.

The project is an educational prototype, not a flight dynamics tool or mission certification system. Its component attributes, budgets, launch limits, orbit effects and scoring logic are explicitly illustrative gameplay assumptions. The NASA Mars Trek map layer supplies real planetary terrain context; the mission assessment itself is a simplified game model.
details:
MISSIONFORGE is an interactive space mission design simulator that helps users understand how to plan and design a space mission. Users can select a mission objective, choose spacecraft components, configure the launch vehicle and orbit, and view important mission parameters such as mass, budget, power, data storage, and communication capacity.
The simulator provides real-time calculations and checks basic engineering constraints to help users understand whether their selected spacecraft configuration is suitable for the mission. It also provides a mission assessment with scores and feedback based on the selected configurations.
The main aim of MISSIONFORGE is to make space mission planning easier, more interactive, and educational, especially for students and beginners interested in space technology and aerospace engineering.
The project was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. NASA Mars Trek resources are used for the Mars-related map and exploration component. Artificial intelligence tools were also used to assist with parts of the project development and preparation.
MISSIONFORGE is creative because it combines different aspects of spacecraft design into one interactive platform. It helps users understand the importance of balancing mission requirements, spacecraft capabilities, and engineering limitations while planning a space mission.
